description: List a committee's oral evidence sessions, newest first, with the meeting date, the inquiry, every witness with their role and organisation, and links to the published transcript. Answers "when did the CEO give evidence" and "who has the committee questioned on X". Source: UK Parliament Committees API. Gives transcript links, not the transcript text or video. (cost: 1 credit)

committeeId.description: integer, required, committee id from committee_search (e.g. 158 = Treasury Committee)

take.description: integer, optional, how many sessions to return (1-50), default 10

name: committee_evidence_sessions
